name: Commitment To God
overview: Scripture calls believers to a wholehearted commitment to God, characterized by trusting Him fully and seeking His guidance in all things. The Psalms emphasize asking the Lord to teach His ways and lead in uprightness, while Proverbs urges us to commit our works and ways to the Lord, promising that our thoughts will be established when we do so. Jesus encapsulates this commitment as loving God with all our heart, soul, and mind, calling for complete devotion beyond our own understanding.
